Branches/paths validated: persisted Sent at, fallback Recorded at, no fabricated time; unknown authors; merged aliases; batch ownership; no runtime refresh; no author/time refs; Factory existing Jido functions; raw-body/search representation distinctions. Document no automatic legacy author backfill.
Mocking plan: not applicable.
Documentations to update: the files above, adjusting earlier per-task documentation into one coherent owner contract without duplicating policy documents.
Action reuse assessment: no new operation. Documentation describes reuse of Conversations/People/History Action/InputPrompt and Jido APIs, not a new supported Retrieval execution path.
Acceptance: deprecated status is clear, existing code behavior remains intact, and docs accurately describe all user-approved constraints.
